mapper.sql: select e.*,d.defect_no,coalesce(dw.task_id,w.task_id) task_id, coalesce(dw.workpiece_name,w.workpiece_name) workpiece_name,u.nick_name evaluator_name from ndt_evaluation e left join ndt_defect d on d.id=e.defect_id and d.del_flag='0' left join ndt_dicom_object o on o.id=d.original_object_id and o.del_flag='0' left join ndt_dicom_series ds on ds.id=o.series_id and ds.del_flag='0' left join ndt_inspection_position p on p.id=ds.position_id and p.del_flag='0' left join ndt_workpiece dw on dw.id=p.workpiece_id and dw.del_flag='0' left join ndt_workpiece w on w.id=e.workpiece_id and w.del_flag='0' left join sys_user u on u.user_id=e.evaluator_id
mapper.update: update ndt_evaluation set level=#{level},conclusion=#{conclusion},description=#{description},update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate() where id=#{id} and status='DRAFT' and del_flag='0'
update ndt_evaluation set status=#{status},evaluator_id=#{evaluatorId},evaluation_time=sysdate(),update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate() where id=#{id} and del_flag='0'
update ndt_evaluation set del_flag='2',update_time=sysdate() where status='DRAFT' and id in #{id}
